info.description: Identity verification API. Authenticate with x-api-key header.

variable.description: (Required) The request_id the start endpoint returned.

request.description: Smart-ID and Mobile-ID: ask the provider whether the user confirmed, refused or let the prompt lapse, and verify the signed identity when they confirmed. Redirect wallets complete through the user's browser, so for them this only reads the verification back. Answers the verification as it is afterwards.

request.description: Withdraw a pending verification: it is declined as cancelled and never billed. A decided one is returned unchanged. Smart-ID and Mobile-ID: a cancel that arrives while a poll is checking the sign-in waits a few seconds for that poll, then declines it, or returns it verified if the user had already confirmed. A verification the user is completing right now cannot be cancelled (409 verification_in_progress with Retry-After): retry after that many seconds to read its outcome.

request.description: Start a MitID sign-in (Danish Agency for Digital Government; DNK) without any workflow. Billed once, only when the identity is verified. The response carries next_action.type=redirect with the URL to send the user's browser to; the user returns to return_url with request_id and result appended. Read the outcome with GET /v3/id-verification/wallets/verifications/{request_id}/ or from the webhook, never from the URL. Sandbox applications get a deterministic simulation (simulated: true) that never contacts the provider.
